marathon.name: Princess
marathon.bio: Hi humans! My name is Princess. I thought I had a forever home but it just wouldn't stick so I'm back in these kennels once again. Here's what you should know- I'm a sweet and playful girl who deserves the forever kind of love. It's looking like I'll be happiest as the only dog in the home and the jury is still out when it comes to me having any future friendships with cats. I think we'll have to learn the rest about each other as we go- are you in?!

marathon.name: Verdi
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Verdi! I'm a fun loving lady that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home, and let me tell you - I'm a little picky! I'm a diva, and I'm not afraid to say it. I'm not a big fan of being picked up or held, but will curl up in your lap on my own terms - I just like to be in charge. I love to be spoiled and would be best as an only pet. If you think I could be the diva of my dreams then come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Juggle *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: I'm not a lap cat, I'm a working cat and there's a difference. I want to be outside in my element, hunting for food and keeping your shed or barn free of mice and other pests. Do you have a job for me?

marathon.name: Thia
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Thia! I'm a sweet girl that came to HSMC after being found as a stray. I'm a very loving girl that loves people and that would be a purrfect fit in any home! Come visit me soon!*Thia is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Thia please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Ivy
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Ivy! I'm a fun loving girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm very playful, adorable and ready to be YOURS! Come see me soon!*Ivy is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Ivy please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Klaus *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Klaus! I'm a happy guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to go mousing!

marathon.name: Jake
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Jake! I'm looking for a new place to call my home! I'm a quiet guy that takes a little bit of time to warm up to you but soon we will be best of friends! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Old Mother Hubbard *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: I'm a resourceful and independent girlie who prefers a life wild and free. I'd be the perfect guest for your barn or shed and will keep your rodent population at bay!

marathon.name: Honesty
marathon.bio: I've had about enough of life lately. I've seen other dogs come and go and I've waited patiently, but the light and the hope inside of my heart has dimmed a little bit more each time. I'm not telling you this so that you'll feel bad for me, I'm just sharing my truth and hoping the right person hears it; they don't call me Honesty for nothin'. I often lay awake at night wondering what a life outside of the kennel environment would look and feel like. I've thought often about the friends I could make, the places I could sniff, the adventures that await me...but in these four walls I wait. I'm not the kind of dog that does well with waiting around, I'm the kind of dog that needs a purpose. The kind of dog that needs work to do. The kind of dog that needs an experienced handler and a busy schedule. The kind of dog that was never meant for a life in a kennel.Less

marathon.name: Smudgie
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Smudgie! I'm a sweet boy that is looking for a new place to call my home. I'm a great cat that is used to living with lots of other cats, but I think I'd like to be part of a smaller family than the 30 plus I used to. I'm outgoing, friendly and so ready to be adopted! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Ryn
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Ryn! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a very loving girl but I can be a little shy with new people. Not much is known about me before I came to HSMC as I was a stray but staff do know I have a rather unique look to me. As you can tell, one of my pupils are very different than the other. Don't worry though, I'm still very active, playful and loving! It doesn't change a single thing about me. If you think I could be the gal for you come visit me soon!*Ryn is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Ryn please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visitLess

marathon.name: Pepper
marathon.bio: Aren't I just the cutest boy you have ever seen?! My name is Pepper and I can't wait to fall in love with you. I came to the shelter from a multi-cat household and wouldn't mind having a feline friend (or two) in my next home. I'm shy but trying my best to be brave; please go slow and be patient on our first meeting. I have so much potential, I hope you give me a chance to show you.

marathon.name: Karuka
marathon.bio: Hello, my name is Karuka. I am a professional chatterbox, retired mama and belly-rub enthusiast. I came from a crowded home and then raised my 5 kittens. I am an outgoing girl who likes to know what is going on at all times. I'll follow you around the house and tell you all about my day. I am not big on being picked up, but will roll over for belly rubs all day long. I get along with other cats and dogs, and respectful kids. I am looking for a forever home where I can relax, chat with my people, soak up affection and finally enjoy life after motherhood. You'll find me at the City of Schofield Municipal Center!

marathon.name: Bluey
marathon.bio: My name is Bluey! I am here with my 2 friends. A wonderful family helped us out of a situation and now we are ready for our forever home together. Our ages and history are unknown. It's all okay though, the future is bright and that is what we are looking forward to! Is your home too quiet? We can help! We like to make noise whether we are singing ourselves or making music with our toys. Come and meet us!

marathon.name: Penny
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Penny! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I've lived with other cats before and done well, so I will likely do so again! I'm very outgoing and sweet, so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Astronomer *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Astronomer and I'm ready to be your new mouser! Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Pablo
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Pablo! I'm a sweet boy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm active, playful and super loving so you should come meet soon! I've lived with another cat before and done well so I think I could again! Come visit me soon!*Pablo is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Pablo please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Buoy
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Buoy and I'm just bobbing with excitement about finding my forever home! I'm a happy guy that loves people and that would be an excellent fit in just about any home! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Puck
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Puck and boy am I ready to be adopted. You see when I first got to the HSMC I was scared, alone and so afraid of everything. Over time I've really blossomed into my true self. I'm a very sweet boy that loves to be pet and go exploring. If you think a cool cat like me could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Emmie
marathon.bio: Be honest, have you ever seen a happier gal?! My name is Emmie and things are finally starting to look up for me. Life on the streets was pretty lonely and uncertain. I didn't have a place to call home or humans to call my family; I didn't want to get close to anyone and always had my guard up. Coming to the shelter helped me tear down all of the walls I had spent months building; even I don't recognize the dog I used to be. And now that I've healed myself, I'm ready to love you. My age is as golden as my coat and I'm looking for a quiet retirement home that never runs out of head scratches, keeps the treat jar full and tells me I'm beautiful every single day. I'm ok to share my home with a low key dogs or cats and hoping that you will make the rest of my life, the best of my life.Less

marathon.name: Mailbox *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Ready to send a love letter to your next barn cat? Well, I'm Mailbox and I'm ready to catch all of your mice!

marathon.name: Nilan
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Nilan! I'm a handsome guy that made his way to HSMC as a stray. I'm a handsome guy that loves people and would be a purrfect fit in just about any home! If you think a cool cat like me could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Holland
marathon.bio: My name is Holland and I'm hoping you can help me find what I'm looking for. I'm in the market for a few two-legged family members to love and a place to call home. I'm a handsome guy with manners who is social with other dogs and might play too rough with the cat. I love cuddling, playing outside and making new friends. I'm a 10 out of 10 good boy and though I'm not a betting dog, I've got a feeling that adopting you would feel like winning the lottery!

marathon.name: Khajit
marathon.bio: Khajit here, reporting for duty! I'm up to the task of being your new cat and am purring just thinking about the possibility. I'm sweet, soft and curious, too! I came to the shelter as a stray so not much is known about my past but I'm betting I can have a beautiful future with you.

marathon.name: Pepper *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Pepper! I'm a cute little lady that is here looking for a new place to call home! I'm active, playful and ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Olive *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Olive! I'm a sweet little lady that is hoping you will just fall in love with me! I'm very playful, snuggly and sweet so you will just love me! I'd be a great fit with other cats too! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Porter
marathon.bio: Hi friends! My name is Porter and I'm hoping to be the center of your whole world. I was found as a stray and turned over to the shelter but no owner ever called. I guess that means I'm in the market for a new owner and from what I can tell so far, I've come to the right place! There's not much I love more than stuffies and sunshine, but I'd be happy to add you to my list of favorite things. I'm social with other dogs but would need to find the right fit if I were to share my home with one. Cats and small children are a deal breaker for me. I'm ready to live a life I'm proud of with someone who will love me forever and I've got my paws crossed that someone is Y-O-U!

marathon.name: Mr Winkles
marathon.bio: My name is Mr Winkles and I'm a country boy, just looking to live a life I can be proud of. In the life I used to live, I wasn't used to confined spaces or having to meet new people; trust me when I say I've had to put my big boy pants on since arriving at the shelter. I'm looking for a human who can help build my confidence and learn to be the best dog that I can be. I'm happy around other dogs but can be a little intense so finding a canine companion to balance my vibe would be ideal. I don't think I'd be the right fit for a home with small children. I'm just looking for consistency, companionship and mutual adoration- aren't you?

marathon.name: Atticus
marathon.bio: Howdy partners! My name is Atticus and I am excited about EVERYTHING! I've got a lot of laughs and energy to share so hold on tight and let's goooo! Dog friends are a must have in my book, as are belly rubs, sunshine and Pup-Peroni treats. I can't wait to be best friends!

marathon.name: Baby Girl
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Baby Girl. I know what you're thinking, how is a sweet elder feline like me in a shelter? Well, my people were moving and couldn't take me with, that's how. I'm a sweet girl that loves people and that gets along well with other cats. I'd be a purrfect fit in a quieter home who has lots of time to spend with me during my golden years. If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Til
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Til! I'm a handsome feline that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a very outgoing cat that loves people and would be an excellent fit in any home! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Cartier
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Cartier! I'm a sweet little lady that was surrendered to HSMC after my owner could no longer keep me. I'm a shy gal that can be a little sassy at times when you get to know me - but I'm a Siamese, that's what we do! I'm a cat that loves to lounge in the sun and would be good in a home with other cats as well! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Wiktor
marathon.bio: Hello, my name is Wiktor. It is Polish and means 'winner' or 'conqueror'. I am a chatty guy looking to win at the game of life and go home with you. I will cuddle and chill but also just hang around and do my thing. Would you like to help me conquer the step in life and move onto the next? Come see me at the shelter.

marathon.name: Fortune *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: My name is Fortune and if you ask me, I'd say your luck is about to change. I'm the mother in a mother/daughter pair and we're hoping to find our new home together; it's all we've ever known. Sure, we have our tiffs and don't always see eye to eye, but family is all you have in this world and we'll always have each other's backs. I like to keep my circle small and am a little hesitant when it comes to meeting new people but I know that in order to get out of the shelter, I have to get out of my shell. I can be social with other dogs when I'm one on one but may be a little more stand-offish when Buttercup is around. I'm not interested in sharing my home with cats and I have had some interaction with children. I struggled to adjust to the shelter when I first got here and I'm sure there'll be a few growing pains in the process of meeting and moving in with a new family, but I'm going to try my hardest to be brave, bold and beautiful.Less

marathon.name: Knox
marathon.bio: All around me are dogs who are at different stages of acclimating to shelter life; some are brave and make it look easy and some are just trying to right the world that has been turned upside down. Here's the thing, I'm having a hard time. The people I used to love, the dog I used to be, the life I used to know; all of that's gone and I've had to start over new. I tell you this so that you know to take things slow and give me grace when we meet; I've never had to do this before. I'm a loyal and independent girl who would prefer to be the only pet in a quiet household. I need only a few things but very consistently; food/water, love and exercise. Maybe you too have been through a difficult time and felt misunderstood? I'm hoping you're the person who can give me everything that I need and that I may return the favor, too.Less

marathon.name: Reginald
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Reginald, a stately gentlecat that is here hoping you're my new home! I'm a very sweet boy that loves people and that just can't wait to be in my new home! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Whitey
marathon.bio: My name is Whitey! I am here with my 2 friends. A wonderful family helped us out of a situation and now we are ready for our forever home together. Our ages and history are unknown. It's all okay though, the future is bright and that is what we are looking forward to! Is your home too quiet? We can help! We like to make noise whether we are singing ourselves or making music with our toys. Come and meet us!

marathon.name: Insta
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Insta! I'm ready to instantly fall in love with you! And I'm sure you will with me! I'm a sweet cat that loves people and am a total lap cat! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Alvida
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Alvida! I'm a sweet little lady that is here at HSMC looking for a new place call home. I'm a super loving cat that is looking for a new lease on life in an indoor home. I love to be pet and I especially loves snacks of any kind! I've been around other cats before and done well, so I think I would do so again! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Space Cat *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Space Cat and I'm ready to land on your home planet to catch all of those pesky mice! Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Basil *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Basil! I'm a great mouser looking for a new home! Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Sybille
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Sybille! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC hoping you will fall in love with me! I'm very affectionate and loving, so I know I will be the purrfect match for you! Come visit me soon!*Sybille is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Sybille please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Van Der Linde
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Van Der Linde and boy let me tell you do I have a plan. I have a plan to be adopted and to live out my years with a family that will love me forever. I'm a happy guy that doesn't ask for much and will fit seamlessly into your life. You better come adopt me today!

marathon.name: Charity
marathon.bio: Hello, my name is Charity. I am a very sweet girl that is looking to find a family that might like to brush me with a gentil brush, let me walk around and chatter with them, and just be my fur-ever home. If you think I might be the girl for you please come down to the shelter, let's meet.

marathon.name: Buttercup *Bonded Pair*
marathon.bio: Hellllooooo out there! My name is Buttercup and there are a few things you should know before you fall in love with me. 1. I'm a package deal- I was surrendered to the shelter with my mom and when I leave here, I'm taking her with me. 2. I tend to be a little on the dramatic side and am not afraid to cause a scene. 3. Cats are not my friends, I cannot go to a home with cats. 4. This is the face that could be greeting you every time you come home...

marathon.name: Terracotta
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Terracotta! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC as a stray. I'm a great cat that loves attention but can be a little shy until I get to know you! Come visit me soon!*Terracotta is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Terracotta please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Valestin
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Valestin! I'm a handsome guy that wandered his way into HSMC after going on an adventure. I've decided it's time to settle down and find a family to call my own, so please adopt me! I'm playful, outgoing and ready to be yours! Let's adventure together!

marathon.name: Mia
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Mia! I'm a sweet girl that was surrendered to HSMC due to no fault of my own. There were just too many of us felines in the home! I'm a quiet girl that loves attention and would make an excellent fit in just about any home! I'd be a great fit in a home with other cats as well! Come visit me soon!*Mia is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Mia please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Oblivion
marathon.bio: Oblivion here, what's your name? I'm a playful cat who is in need of a friend and a place to call home. I've been left behind and had my heart broken in the past so forgive me if I don't give my trust easily. What do you say we get to know each other better?

marathon.name: Nutella
marathon.bio: My name is Nutella and I just want you to know that I'm trying my very best to be brave. I've taken it slow and steady on the road to adoption and I can't wait until it leads me home to you. I'm mostly overwhelmed in the shelter environment and have been very timid and shy. Staff have been patient and I hope that you will be, too. I would do best in a quiet home where I can be myself and truly blossom. I don't think I would mind the company of other cats or a lazy dog. Maybe you can make all of my dreams come true?*Nutella is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Nutella please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visitLess

marathon.name: Ludwig
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Ludwig and boy am I ready to go home with you! I'm a handsome guy that came to HSMC as a stray. I'm very friendly and outgoing so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Magnet
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Magnet and boy am I hoping to attract my new family to find me! I'm a sweet boy that can be quite shy until you get to know, but with time we will be the best of friends! Come see me soon!

marathon.name: Blu
marathon.bio: My name is Blu and I'm looking for a fresh start. My life has taken some unexpected turns and I'm in the camp that says it's about the destination and not journey. Here's to hoping that all of the roads I've traveled thus far will lead me straight to you. I'm a smart and confident guy who is selective when it comes to other dogs and should not be placed with small dogs or cats. I know a handful of tricks that I'll gladly show you in exchange for a treat and I'm looking forward to the long walks and talks we'll share. I can't wait to love everything about you.

marathon.name: Greeney
marathon.bio: My name is Greeney! I am here with my 2 friends. A wonderful family helped us out of a situation and now we are ready for our forever home together. Our ages and history are unknown. It's all okay though, the future is bright and that is what we are looking forward to! Is your home too quiet? We can help! We like to make noise whether we are singing ourselves or making music with our toys. Come and meet us!

marathon.name: Jiko
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Jiko! I'm a fun loving cat that is hoping you will come to adopt me! I'm a playful fella that loves people and would make an excellent snuggler! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Aurick
marathon.bio: What's black and white and will love you forever? ME! My name is Aurick, pleased to meet you. I'm a gentle and affectionate guy that would rather be snuggling at home on the couch with you than in a kennel at the shelter. I needed a little TLC when I got here but I'm back on all four feet and my bags are already packed. What are you waiting for? You'll find me at Wild Birds Unlimited in Rib Mountain!

marathon.name: Florean
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Florean! I'm a handsome guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I arrived to the shelter as a stray but I'm ready to leave with my new family! I'm outgoing, soft and ready to be YOURS!

marathon.name: Jake 2
marathon.bio: Don't worry, you're not seeing double, there are two Jakes here! They call me Jake 2 and if you ask me, I'm the one you should adopt! I'm a shy guy but this tough exterior melts quickly once I get to know you. I'm happiest in the company of other cats and am used to an adult only home but am open to exploring other options. Come on in, we'll talk about it.

marathon.name: Corwyn
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Corwyn! I'm a happy guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a friendly guy that loves people, snacks and getting lots of love! I'm super ready to be adopted so come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Siridean
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Siridean! I'm a sweet girl that made her way to HSMC as a stray. But, I know I'll soon be leaving with my forever family! I'm petite, adorable and ready to move in with you! Come visit me soon!*Siridean is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Siridean please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Misa
marathon.bio: You look like someone who likes to have FUN and well, that's one thing we already have in common! My name is Misa and I'm looking for a place to call home and a family to love. I'm a high energy girl who is ready to take the world by storm. I'm selective when it comes to other dogs (but my bestie Remi is here and I like her) and may be a bit much for a home with cats. I love feeling the fresh air in my fur and having my favorite human at my side. See you soon?

marathon.name: Willa
marathon.bio: They call me Willa and tell me that I'm a special girl who deserves the world, but my troubled past makes me doubt that's true. I was on my own for at least 2.5 weeks before getting trapped and brought to the shelter; it's hard to go through something like that and not have trust issues. Getting to the adoption floor has been a long time coming and I'm thankful for the staff who got me here but I'm ready for bigger and better things with someone who's love is true and won't give up when the going gets tough. I love wide open spaces, water, fetch, jolly balls and the wind in my fur. Once I know and trust you, you'll see the side of me that gets lost in the stress of the shelter and the uncertainty of a constantly changing environment. I don't love other dogs and I don't give my heart away easily but I promise I'm worth the time and the energy. (Oh and breed experience is a big plus in my book!)Less

marathon.name: Chewy
marathon.bio: Hey friends! They call me Chewy and tell me that I'm a good boy and I'm sure hoping that you feel the same way, too. I've got beautiful blue eyes, a stubborn streak and the smarts and wit common to my breed. I enjoy spending time outside, playing fetch and singing the songs of my people. I'm tolerant of other dogs but do not want to share treats or high value items. You look like you could be a forever kind of human, let's make my dreams come true!

marathon.name: Katze *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Katze!~ I'm a great mouser that is looking for my next mousing job!

marathon.name: Clawzilla
marathon.bio: Rawwwr! I'm Clawzilla and I'm here to take over your home! I'm a fun loving kitten that was found as a stray and brought to HSMC. I'm now ready to rule my own kingdom and boy I hope it's with YOU!

marathon.name: Air Fryer
marathon.bio: I came to HSMC as a very shy girl. It has taken me a long time to come out of my shell, but I have and I am now ready to make new friend and find my for human(s). I am still shy, but I am sweet. I do love attention and I enjoy playing with toys. I will do best in a calmer environment without young children. Do you think you have room in your heart for a girl like me?*Air Fryer is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Air Fryer please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Astrology *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Looking for a good mouser? Well, your stars are in alignment because I'm the best mouser here!

marathon.name: Marston
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Marston! I'm a friendly fella that is in need of a place to call home. I used to run the streets with a gang of other cats, but now I'm ready to settle down and find my true calling with my forever family. I'm a loving guy that loves people and that just can't wait to find a home. Come visit me soon!

clark.name: Missy (Adoption Fee Sponsored!)
clark.bio: Meet Missy! Missy came to CCHS as a stray a couple of times in November, and after being reclaimed the first time, her owners decided to not reclaim her when she came in the second time after multiple attempts to contact them. This sweet girl is about 5 years and 8 months old and weighs roughly 42.4lbs currently. Missy is a total baby! She may have some scars, but we assure you this sweet girl is nothing but smiles and tail wags when it comes to being loved on! We can't guarantee perfection as this big baby as seen some things, but with a gentle hand and a bit of patience we can guarantee undying love and loyalty! Missy has been known to do well with other dogs but will need a meet and greets on site to make sure the pups approve of each other before making that journey home. We aren't entirely certain what her exact breed makeup is, but we can tell you she is 100% Snuggable House Hippo! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Apply for Missy today!

clark.name: Bart
clark.bio: Ay Caramba! Bart is stealing hearts again! Bart came to CCHS with his 7 siblings towards the very end of December from a local farm, and is now the last of the bunch looking for his furever home. This lively Heeler mix is about 6 months old and weighs roughly 24lbs currently. Bart is such a goofball! He can be a little awkward in his approach but he's hoping his adorable looks can distract you from that! While we aren't entirely certain what his exact breed makeup is, we can tell you he is 100% North American Look-at-Dem-Ears! He is all sweetness, cudles, and "please let me sit in your lap for the rest of forever" energy. His hobbies include: following you around, being as close to you as possible, turning into a 24 ib lap dog, looking at you like you hung the moon. he just wants a person to love and call his own. With any puppy, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success to the pup. Apply for Bart today!

clark.name: Darla (Adoption Fee Sponsored!)
clark.bio: Meet Darla! Darla came to CCHS as a stray from the township of Fremont earlier this January. This pretty Red Heeler is about a year and a half old and weighs roughly 35.2lbs currently. Darla is an absolute ray of awkward sunshine! She is such a smart gal but didn't quite grasp onto the social skills so she hopes you can look past her being a bit forward with her affection! Darla is a tad protective of her food, so she'd prefer being the only dog in the home to avoid her anxiety around sharing. With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Apply for Darla today!

clark.name: Patty
clark.bio: Meet Patty! Patty came to CCHS with her 4 kittens towards the beginning of March as strays from the Greenwood area. This quirky Tabby is about a year old and weighs roughly 7lbs currently. Patty is a bit of an odd gal! She always looks so surprised with her big eyes! If you're looking for a cat that will have you second guessing your every move with a side eye, Patty is the one for you! Her interesting aura will draw you in and have you both in awe and mild confusion as to how you ended up with such a goofy cat! Apply for Patty today!

clark.name: Thor
clark.bio: Meet Thor! Thor came to CCHS as an owner surrender after his owner had to take on caring for their family member. This handsome Red Heeler mix is about 1 year old and weighs roughly 28.5lbs currently. Thor is a total loverboy! He has a friendly demeanor and is down for any adventure! Thor would benefit from an active family that can help burn off some of that energy he has! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Apply for Thor today!

clark.name: Tuff
clark.bio: Meet Tuff! Tuff came to CCHS as an owner surrender with another dog, after their owner's health started making it difficult to keep up with them and their care. This handsome guy is about 7 years old and weighs roughly 70.5lbs currently. Tuff is a high-spirited pup that is ready to be loyal to anyone who gives him treats and tells him he's handsome! He would benefit from an active, but patient furever home that's willing to meet him where he's at in life! Tuff can be a little hesitant when meeting with new men, but with a slow introduction he is sure to be besties with just about anyone! While we aren't entirely certain what his exact breed makeup is, we can tell you that he is 100% Soft-Coated House Hippo! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Tuff today!

clark.name: Lea
clark.bio: Meet Lea! Lea came to CCHS as an owner surrender with another dog, after their owner's health started making it difficult to keep up with them and their care. This gentle Great Pyrenees mix is about 5 years old and weighs roughly 94.7lbs currently. Lea is a gentle giant through and through! She's got a sweetness to her soul that is almost magnetic! Lea would benefit from a furever family that understands her breed's grooming and exercise needs. We aren't entirely certain what her exact breed makeup is, but we can tell you she is 100% Great Gal! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Lea today!

clark.name: Tiny
clark.bio: Meet Tiny! Tiny came to CCHS as an owner surrender, previously set to be a barn cat however a little bit of wobble in her step had the owner bringing her over to us. This itty-bitty bashful gal is about 11 months old and weighs roughly 4.4lbs currently. Tiny is a sweet gal who is just a little unsure of things! She wasn't given a lot of socialization so she is the teeniest timid, but one thing for certain is that she looooves affection! She does not always know how to ask for it, but with a gentle touch and a little patience, she's very easy to win over. Tiny currently resides in our Kitty City with a number of other feline friends. Apply for Tiny today!

clark.name: Ella
clark.bio: Meet Ella! Ella came to CCHS as a stray from the Sherwood township area earlier this April. This gorgeous gal is about 5 years old and weighs roughly 59.8lbs currently. Ella is such a well-behaved lovergirl! She is all smiles all the time and absolutely loves to steal kisses whenever she can! We don't know terribly much about her past, but we can tell you she is looking towards the future with the same brightness we see in her eyes every day! While we aren't entirely certain what her exact breed makeup is, we can tell you she is 100% Happy to be Involved! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Ella today!

clark.name: Vinter
clark.bio: Meet Vinter! Vinter came to CCHS as an owner surrender with his sister, Luna, after their living situation became unsuitable for them leading their owner to make the difficult decision to surrender to give them an opportunity to thrive elsewhere. This handsome Sheepdog/Poodle mix is about 3 years and 4 months old and weighs roughly 87.2lbs currently. Vinter is a bit of a bashful guy! He takes a little bit to warm up to new people but is very food motivated, so a few treats here and there might just wiggle your way up his totem pole! While Vinter gets along with other dogs, he would benefit greatly from being the only pup in his furever home to help get his nervous system back on track after the stress he endured prior to coming into CCHS. With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Vinter is very behaved on a leash, he is very well mannered, and knows basic commands( sit, lay etc) Apply for Vinter today!

clark.name: Kiara
clark.bio: Meet Kiara! Kiara came to CCHS as a medical transfer from another humane society after her ears developed some pretty nasty infections and needed more in-depth care. This beautiful Mixed Breed is about 7 years old and weighs roughly 76.2lbs currently. Kiara is a delightfully sweet senior that is ready for a furever family of her own to live out the rest of her days with! With Kiara's ears needing some extra tending to, it is important for her to go home with a family who will stay vigilant in keeping her happy and healthy through the rest of her life. While we don't know much about this darling gal, even her breed makeup stays a mystery, we can tell you she is 100% Mayor of Snuggle City! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Kiara today!

clark.name: Iris
clark.bio: Meet Iris! Iris came to CCHS from a local farm earlier in May. Iris is one beautiful girl! She has a fluffy black coat with a little white and very perky ears! She is a Border Collie mix and weighs 35.6#. She is about 11 months old (estimated DOB 5/31/25). As would be expected with a Border Collie Iris is a very high energy girl. She walks well on a leash and loves her toys! She is a happy girl, as you can tell from all the smiles in her pictures. Iris will do best with an active family with lots going on to keep her busy and burn off some of that energy. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Iris today!

clark.name: Luke
clark.bio: Meet Luke! Luke came to CCHS from a local farm earlier in May. Luke isn't very old yet at just 1 year old (estimated date of birth 5/11/25) and he weighs 29.5 #. Luke is a Blue Heeler (or Australian Cattle Dog). He is handsome with his black, white and merle coat that's a little fluffy. He has great perky ears, too. Luke is a friendly but shy guy and is a little overwhelmed at the Shelter due to all the changes he has experienced lately. He isn't too great at walking on a leash and will learn how to do that better. The great thing is that he's a smart boy and is ready to learn lots of new stuff. He will do best in a new family with lots of patience and love who is willing to give him time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Luke today!

clark.name: Perdita
clark.bio: Meet Perdita! Perdita came to CCHS when she was part of an unexpected litter, she isn't very old yet at just 9 weeks old. Perdita is a Dalmatian mix. She is beautiful, with her black, and white short hair coat. She will do best in a new family with lots of patience and love who is willing to give her time to learn and adjust, she's still learning! With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Perdita can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today!

clark.name: Coco Chanel
clark.bio: Meet Coco Chanel! Coco Chanel came to us as a surrender due to her owners health. Coco Chanel is fancy and sophisticated just like her name suggests.She weighs 8.8#. If you're in her presence get ready to feel like a VIP. She is a beautiful long haired Calico, she's beautiful, and she knows it but loves to be told anyway. if you are looking for a new best friend apply today! Coco Chanel would love to meet you!

clark.name: Ruby (bonded with Archie)
clark.bio: Meet Ruby! Ruby came to us when her little human developed allergies. Ruby is beautiful with a side of mysterious and sophistication. she has medium long black hair, and beautiful green eyes. She is ready to find her new home and prove she has more to offer than just her looks, she also has a very sweet personality to seal the deal! if you're looking for a new best friend, come apply for Ruby today! Ruby came to CCHS with her best friend. Archie, and they are closely bonded. They do need to be adopted together. However, we always have a "2-for-1" adoption fee special on cats and kittens at CCHS, so both Ruth and Archie can be adopted together for just $50!

clark.name: Archie (bonded with Ruby)
clark.bio: Meet Archie! Archie came to us when his tiny human owner discovered a cat allergy. Archie is a big guy, with an even bigger heart! This handsome tabby is all about the love. Archie is first to greet you, with a big purr, and the last to leave your side. He's always up for a good rub or scratch! He is gentle with his paws and has a purr that kicks in the moment you get near him. He has a very affectionate and easygoing personality, loves cozy naps and is looking for a loyal loving companion. Big bonus: big cat= bigger cuddles! If you're ready for a best friend to give you his whole heart, Archie is ready to give you his. Apply today! Archie came to CCHS with his best friend. Ruby, and they are closely bonded. They do need to be adopted together. However, we always have a "2-for-1" adoption fee special on cats and kittens at CCHS, so both Archie and Ruby can be adopted together for just $50!

clark.name: Connie
clark.bio: meet Connie! Connie came to CCHS due to no fault of her own, her owner abandoned her in a basement of a previous home. Connie is a beautiful coonhound. She is 4 years old and weighs 72.2#. She is tan/brown and silver in color. She will do best with someone/a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Connie can't wait to meet her new family and get all the love she deserves. Apply today!

clark.name: Florence
clark.bio: Meet Florence. Florence. Florence came to us as an abandoned stray, she was pregnant when she came in. She currently weighs 5# She has had her babies and nurtured them enough to leave the nest, and now its her time to be loved and doted on! Florence is willing to accept all the back and cheek rubs offered. She is ready to become your newest addition and be the baby for a change. Apply today to show her some love!

clark.bio: Reyn came to CCHS due to no fault of her own, she was abandoned in a basement. Reyn is a coonhound with short brindle fur. She will do best in a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her love and time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Reyn can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today!

clark.bio: Nana came to CCHS due to being abandoned in a basement. Nana is a Aussie mix. She is 4 years old and weighs 64.8#. She has short brown/tan fur. She will do best in a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Nana can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today!

clark.bio: Savannah came to CCHS due to no fault of her own. Savannah is an Australian shepherd. She has long reddish brown and white fur. She weighs 60# She is very enthusiastic and looking for someone to match, she has a lot of love to give, and wants to make sure you know it. She will do best in a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Savannah can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today!

clark.name: Cheyanne
clark.bio: Meet Cheyanne! Cheyanne came to CCHS as a surrender, but to no fault of her own. she weighs in at 71.6#. Cheyanne is a gentle, love‑soaked Australian Shepherd with a mellow spirit and a heart that’s ready to belong to her person. She carries herself with quiet sweetness, beautiful markings, and a calm confidence that makes everyone feel at ease. Cheyanne doesn’t ask for much — just a soft voice, a kind hand, and someone who will let her give all the affection she’s been saving. She’s the kind of dog who becomes your shadow, your comfort, and your loyal companion for life. If you’re looking for a dog who will love you with her whole heart, Cheyanne is ready.

clark.name: Juno
clark.bio: Meet Juno! Juno came to CCHS as a stray on the side of the road. Juno is a happy spunky little guy! He weighs 15.3#. He is happy to be the center of attention and will always greet you with a tail wag! Juno is a small-medium mixed breed with short/medium black fur. Juno is only about 11 weeks old, and all ready to find his new family and his forever home.

clark.name: Vanna White
clark.breed: Australian Cattle Dog / Blue Heeler & Border Collie.
clark.bio: Meet Vanna White! Vanna came to CCHS with her 4 other litter mates. Vanna White is ready to turn the letters and turn your house into her home. She is 9 weeks old (estimated DOB 4/2/26) and currently weighs 8.2#. This sweet girl may start off shy but beneath that cautious exterior is a playful puppy who wants so badly to love and be loved. She enjoys typical puppy fun- toys, wrestling her litter mates, exploring new things and soaking up the gentle affection once she feels safe. Vanna is looking for a family willing to give her time, patience and kindness as she learns that the good life is just the beginning. Apply for Vanna White today!

clark.name: Alfalfa
clark.bio: Meet our adorable little Alfalfa. Alfalfa was born here from our cat Florence. Alfalfa is a tiny bundle of energy with a heart full of wonder. She is all black with the cutest little pure white tip on her tail! She is everything kittens should be — playful, curious, and always ready to turn anything into a toy. Whether she's chasing shadows, pouncing on crinkle balls, or tumbling over each other in a fit of silliness, this baby bring joy to every moment. Alfalfa is also wonderfully affectionate, happy to curl up for snuggles once playtime winds down. If you’re looking for a kitten who will fill your home with laughter, love, and a little bit of mischief, she's the one for you! Apply today to seal the deal.

adams.name: Midnight
adams.bio: Midnight is a 1-year-old tabby with movie-star looks and a velvety-soft coat you have to feel to believe. She’s playful, curious, and always ready to chase a toy like it’s her full-time job.This girl loves affection and will happily soak up attention, on her terms, of course. Midnight appreciates a slow introduction to other cats and a home that understands she sometimes needs her space. If she’s feeling overwhelmed or doesn’t want to be bothered, she may make a quick exit - but give her patience and kindness, and you’ll see just how incredibly sweet she truly is.She’s equal parts fun and tender, with a dash of diva charm. If you’re looking for a soft, playful companion who will keep you entertained and then curl up for love, Midnight might just be your perfect match.Less

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it.This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up.She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin.She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you?Less

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee.Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside.Much sleeping is had. And snacks.Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her.And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods!Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. fetch.name: Bluey
fetch.bio: The best way to describe Bluey is a TON of fun packed into a 22 lb package. This little peanut is a high energy girl who loves life and lives it to the fullest. Bluey loves other dogs and would do best in a hone with a fur sibling who loves a good wrestling match, game of chase or tug of war. Bluey is small, mighty and fiesty so any fur sibling will have to be good with her being in their face, egging them on to play. Bluey is shy to warm up to new people but rest assured, she loves her foster humans and comes happily running when called, all excited to get loving from her humans. Shes ok with car rides, is good with the resident cat and was good with her foster parents young nephews when they visited. Shes house trained, kennel trained and walks fine on a leash. Her favorite foods are peanut butter and broccoli and she loves a good chew bone. If your looking for a pint size, fun loving pup, Bluey might just be the girl for you!You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Caesar
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Meet Caesar! Caesar is a big, lovable boy with an even bigger heart. This handsome Mastiff/Great Dane/Lab/Pit mix tips the scales at 88 lbs — but don’t let his size fool you. He’s a gentle giant who gets along beautifully with kids, dogs, cats, and people of all kinds.Caesar comes fully ready for his forever home: neutered, up-to-date on all vaccinations (including kennel cough), house trained, and crate trained. No medical or behavioral concerns — just a sweet, well-rounded pup looking for someone to love.He’s got a moderate-to-high energy level, so he’d thrive with a family that enjoys walks, playtime, or just an active lifestyle. He does tend to be a little cautious around men at first, but with patience and consistency, he warms right up. He just wants to know he’s safe — and once he does, he’ll be your most loyal companion.If you’re looking for a big, beautiful, good-natured dog who fits right into family life, Caesar might just be your perfect match. Apply today — we have a feeling it’ll be love at first sight. You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Hi, I'm Turbo, but don't let the name fool you! I'm currently accepting applications for the position of 'Permanent Human Companion'. My qualifications include: expert-level napping skills (especially on the couch), a strong work ethic when it comes to belly rubs, and a proven ability to make you laugh with my dramatic snorts and dramatic sighs. Dislikes include: sudden loud noises, riding in the car, being left out of the snack loop, and having my naps interrupted. Strengths: cuddles, loyalty, and a healthy appreciation for naps. I'm looking for a home with a comfy couch, a reliable source of treats, and a human who understands that sometimes, a dog just needs to be left alone (to nap, of course)."You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Harley (23)
fetch.bio: Oh my, this is a big world that I had no idea even existed outside of those walls. Since being out, I've been experiencing so many new things; sounds, smells, human interaction! (Oh, uh, I'm Harley by the way.)So far, I've discovered that I really enjoy the presence of other dogs, don't mind rides in the car, and that all humans aren't that bad after all. In fact, I'm so curious what my foster humans are doing, that I like to be their shadow. Though I'm still not at 100%, house training isn't going so bad. I'm gradually getting there! When going for walks on the leash I sometimes have my moments where I stop and freeze. I don't know if it's out of fear, confusion, or if I just need a minute to take things in. But I need my new humans to understand that I am still navigating this huge change after all. In fact, I typically present as shy when you first meet me, which is why I think no one has really fallen hard for me yet. But, after some time together, we'll grow that bond. I just need some time. Don't get me wrong, I do enjoy playing too once I warm up to you and the other dogs in the home!I want to be transparent though as I'd prefer that my forever family completely understands that this transition will likely be hard. When you initially go to attach my leash, I get a little nervous. When you close the door to my crate, I start feeling all sorts of emotions, which makes me paw at the door and bark a bit -this comes and goes, but I do eventually settle. However, when I'm no

fetch.name: Sid
fetch.bio: Hello! My name is Sid and I'm currently in the market for a new best friend!! I love cuddles and hanging out with my people while we go on fun adventures. If it were up to me I would be glued to your side all the time.... However, I know that's not always possible, so when needed I'm perfectly happy to chill on my own in my kennel. I may be a bit picky about dog friends but I sure do love hanging out with people!In addition to cuddles and following you around the house, I also enjoy going on lots of outdoor adventures! Running around in the snow and going for long hikes are the best!! I also like playing training/mental stimulation games to wear me out when the weather doesn't allow for a lot of time outside. I learn fast and am eager to please my people, I just need a patient and gentle friend to teach me.So if you're also in the market for a new best friend to go on adventures with and then cuddle up with at the end of the day then I'm your guy and you should apply to adopt me today!!You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Auggie (Nickel)
fetch.bio: Auggie here! I’m a 7-month-old pup with a big personality and an even bigger heart. I’m energetic, playful, and always ready for fun — whether that means zooming around the yard, learning new tricks, or soaking up attention from my favorite humans. I’m a smart boy who loves to learn, and I already know commands like “sit” and “come.” I’m also potty trained and kennel trained, which makes me a pretty awesome roommate if I do say so myself!I get along great with other dogs and even cats, so I’d fit right into a home with furry siblings. My ideal day includes exercise, playtime, training, and plenty of love from my people.I’m still working on feeling more confident around strangers, especially men. Because of that, I’m looking for a patient, calm home that understands I may need a little extra time to warm up. With positive experiences, consistency, and gentle guidance, I know I can continue building confidence and become the very best version of myself.If you’re willing to put time into training, exercise, and helping a young, smart pup grow, I promise to reward you with lots of love, laughs, and loyal companionship. I can’t wait to find my forever family!You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Charly
fetch.bio: Meet Charly — Your Future Best Friend! Charly is a lovable 7yearold pup searching for a cozy, caring forever home. She’s the perfect mix of gentle, affectionate, and playful — a steady companion who brings warmth to every room she enters.About Charly:• Age: 7 years old• Friendly, calm, and incredibly loyal• Great with kids — patient, gentle, and loves being part of family life• Gets along wonderfully with other dogs• Not compatible with cats• Enjoys snuggles, belly rubs, and relaxed walks• Healthy, uptodate on vet care, and ready for adoptionCharly has a big heart and so much love left to give. She’s hoping to find a family who will cherish her just as much as she’ll cherish them. Adopt, don’t shop. Give Charly her welldeserved second chance.You can apply for her at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Walter
fetch.bio: Hey! I’m Walter! I’ve been with Fetch for awhile now, and I’m STILL looking for my forever family. Let me reintroduce myself: I’m a happy boy who likes to be a part of what’s going on. Whether we’re making dinner, you’re showering, or doing laundry - doesn’t matter to me as long as we’re together. I can supervise any project you got goin on! I am always excited to show you what I have. I am kennel/crate trained and I know to do my business outside! I’m strong, like you can tell I work out and all that. I know how to walk nicely on a leash but sometimes I seriously forget it’s even attached, this nose of mine is soooo powerful it’s crazy. I am special, my foster mom says it all the time. Just to make sure I get enough love and attention, it would be best if I am the only “good boy” in my forever home. I run like a graceful rhino and my white hair is so silky soft you won’t be able to resist loving on me. I have gotten myself into a couple situations and I really want to leave my troubled past behind me and move forward with people who get me. People who know tell me that I need structure and leadership: if you let me be the pack leader, I will take advantage of that situation. I love training and learning, my foster mom is kick butt cool at it, she has lots more information for you since I am sooo special, so apply and let’s get this party started!

fetch.name: Daisy
fetch.bio: Hi, we're Daisy and Bella. We have found ourselves being surrendered to rescue because our parents had to go to assisted living. We were very well cared for and loved! fetch.bio: The name’s Frank, and I’ve got a lot of love to give. Whoever you are, wherever you came from — I’m glad you’re here. Dogs, cats, kids, strangers passing by? I don’t discriminate. My heart has room for everyone, and I mean that sincerely.My foster home keeps me busy. There’s a younger dog I tear around with from sunup to sundown, and an older guy who likes his personal space (I read the room — we’re cool). I’ve settled in well, which honestly doesn’t surprise me. I’m pretty adaptable.The indoor stuff? Handled. I’m fully kennel trained and can sleep in one no problem — though between you and me, cuddling is where I truly shine. I’ve also never once thought about crossing my foster home’s underground fence. Not my style. My recall is coming along nicely too, even if my brain occasionally goes on a little vacation without telling me.I am absolutely wild about kids. Playing, snuggling, following them from room to room — sign me up for all of it. Meeting new people gets me pretty fired up too, which means leash walks are still something we’re polishing together. I’ve got the enthusiasm, I just need a little guidance channeling it.If you want a dog who will love you loudly, loyally, and with his whole goofy heart — I think we’d make a pretty great team. *a side note about Frank: Frank was rescued with cherry eyes. fetch.bio: Do you even look around at your family and think'Is someone missing?'Maybe there is a Shiba shaped hole in your heart?Well, you can fill that niche, with me - Niche!I'm a generally happy lady who enjoys sprinting in the snow and chasing my Shiba friends.I'm still learning to trust humans, but I find women much less intimidating. As much as Sir Foster insists he isn't gonna eat me, I just don't believe that to be true.Ms Foster gives good neck scratches, but I have to be in the mood for them.I don't mind my kennel and I think I like the car. But I love a quite corner to nap as well as some I door space to pace. I also enjoy hoarding my toys (socks and underwear are included in 'toys') in my bed.I'm still learning about being a dog. I have to practice being on a leash and being more social with humans. Once I trust you, I'll be a great pal!My fosters loves Shibas but recommend people read up on the breed. fetch.name: Scott (4)

So, while I navigate what's acceptable behavior and not, I need someone who is patient and understanding with their responses as I don't want to be reliving my rough past. Keep away is one of my favorite games whether you like it or not. My foster mom is trying to teach me that I can't steal socks, dishtowels, blankets, shampoo bottles or anything that I feel is fair game. Boring!Anywho, I would really love a home that has another dog for me to learn and grow with. As I'm still adjusting to this change, I've been working through some resource guarding with my high priority chew treats. So in other words, I may need someone who knows how to handle that and can be patient, especially if there's other dogs in the home. Something to also make note of is that I don't really understand personal space, so I may be in your bubble or my dog sibling's bubble without seeing an issue. My foster mom says I have "selective hearing" cause sometimes I can just zone her right out. I hear it's a beagle thing, but it could also be because I'm still taking in all these noises and smells. southwood.name: Remy
southwood.bio: Meet Remy — a bright eyed Husky with a big voice!This handsome boy is full of curiosity—he loves exploring every new scent, sound, and corner of the world around him. He loves to chase after a ball for hours, running and wagging his tail, ready for 'just one more throw.' He enjoys taking a splash in the pool in the hot summer heat. He's smart and energetic and thrives when he has both mental and physical activity to keep him engaged. If you love a pup with personality and expression, you'll adore Remy! Does not do the best with cats or children. Unknown with other dogs.Less

southwood.name: Adam *Diabetic, In Foster*
southwood.bio: Adam is a handsome senior gentleman that would love a forever home to relax, unwind, and receive lots of love and give it in return! Adam was brought to us as a stray, and we soon realized that Adam was dealing with unmanaged diabetes. Adam has responded to his insulin very well and is back on track, and is ready for a home that is willing to help him be healthy and happy! Adam needs to be on a low-carb diet (this is easy, and we can give you a list of good foods that ARE NOT expensive!) and he also needs to eat only twice a day, and receive his insulin 30 minutes after each meal. Because his diabetes went unmanaged for an unknown length of time before he arrived to us, he does walk a bit flat on his back legs. This has gotten better now that his diabetes is managed, but he may always walk a little funny. Adam uses the litter box just fine and has no issues! He is an older gentleman though, and may need some minor help with grooming and brushing. Adam is so, so sweet and has so much love to give - please consider letting him into your heart and he will love you back tenfold!Less

She adores getting some pets while in your company, maybe even a few kisses.Has done well with a dog previouslyUnknown with cats and other animalsLess

southwood.name: Evie

If you are looking for a fun loving cat who would be great with your family or would like more information, please give us at call at 715-423-0505 to schedule an appointment to meet with her.

We will gladly provide her adopter with a list of foods that agree with her tummy and will keep her comfortable and healthy!Less

southwood.bio: Meet this handsome white mixed-breed sweetheart named Tank -- around 2 years old and 100 % certified goofball.
